_comment: Single source of truth for model tiers. Change a tier's model here and the whole app follows.
_verified_against: Verified 2026-10-14 against GET /v1/models on the live account. Exact-match, case-sensitive: a mis-cased ID returns HTTP 404 on the call. NOTE: the model ID published in Nebius docs for Nano (nvidia/nvidia-nemotron-3-nano-30b-a3b) does not exist - the live ID is nvidia/NVIDIA-Nemotron-3-Nano-30B-A3B. Run spike/step0_spike.py --list-models to re-verify (free).
_thinking_note: These Nemotron models are REASONING models: they emit a reasoning trace before the answer, and those tokens are billed as output. Measured on this account, enabling reasoning on Nano cost 229 output tokens and 2.5s for a 38-token JSON routing decision - and at max_tokens=300 the reasoning often consumed the whole budget, returning empty content and breaking the router. 'thinking': false sends chat_template_kwargs.enable_thinking=false, which cut that to 38 tokens and 1.1s. Keep thinking ON for explanations (quality) and OFF for classification (waste).

nano.use_for: routing, tab actions, short replies, JSON-shaped classification

ultra.use_for: hard reasoning only: readiness estimates, study-time allocation, tough concept explanations

budgets._note: What each of these actually does, since a ceiling nobody checks reads like a safeguard: max_steps_per_request bounds a whole request, tools included (Step 9); max_requests_per_session_demo caps one demo visitor, charged before anything is routed (Step 10); warn_over_usd_per_request warns on the turn that crosses it - the sentence is appended to the reply so it is heard, nothing is blocked, a missing or unusable value falls back to 0.05 and an explicit 0 turns it off (Step 11); total_credit_usd is *reported* and not enforced, so nothing stops spending when it runs out; max_output_tokens_per_request is sent as max_tokens on every call; max_input_tokens_per_request is read by nothing at all - the prompt is bounded in pieces (page text, tool results) rather than as a total.
